summary: Backend-only regression on new fields (book.cover, member.photo) and borrow/return flows against public URL. 18/18 pytest tests passed. Verified: auth cookie+me+logout, 3 roles, invalid login 401 (using unique identifier to avoid real-account lockout), auth-required for all endpoints, catalog/shelves listings, cover field present on all books and preserved through POST/GET, photo base64 preserved on member POST/GET, siswa forbidden from POST books/members and DELETE books, delete-nonexistent 404, pinjam->Dipinjam transition, double-pinjam 400, kembali->Tersedia transition, missing-entity 404, reports structure (transactions/incoming/missing arrays), dashboard counts shape.

minor.issue: 'incoming' is hardcoded to 4, not derived from any collection (documented by main agent as known mock).
'incoming' and 'missing' are static seed arrays, not from DB (documented mock).

critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 109 compares locked_until string with now_iso() string - works only because both are ISO UTC with same format, fragile if format changes.
POST /api/books and /api/members return 200 on create instead of 201 (minor convention).
/api/dashboard 'incoming' hardcoded to 4; /api/reports incoming/missing are static seed data - should either be real collections or renamed to indicate demo data.
seed_data_creation: Created transient TEST_ books/members during CRUD tests; books cleaned up via DELETE. Test members with TEST_ prefix remain (no delete endpoint). Borrow/return cycle leaves 2 transaction history entries (net book state unchanged).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend endpoints verified green on preview URL. New cover/photo fields correctly persist and are returned. Rate limit avoidance: test_invalid_login_returns_401 uses a unique random identifier each run so real demo accounts never approach the 5-fail lockout threshold. Known mocks: dashboard.incoming hardcoded 4; reports.incoming and reports.missing are static seed data.
